mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales_user_pii_secure ( employee_id, phone, email, birth_date, retired_at, purged_at ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{birthDate}, #{retiredAt}, #{purgedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT employee_id AS employeeId, phone, email, birth_date AS birthDate, retired_at AS retiredAt, purged_at AS purgedAt FROM sales_user_pii_secure ORDER BY retired_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
